create_PacknetAction: create a PacknetAction agent with input dimension 8, output dimension 2, and hidden size 256
build_make_model: build a neural network model with configurable layer normalization and LeakyReLU activation
run_forward_PacknetAction: run the forward pass to sample actions and compute log probabilities for the current task
refactor_prune: refactor the prune method to apply synaptic masks preserving important weights across tasks
review_set_task: review the set_task method to create a new task model or switch to an existing one
